_comment: Machine-readable port of SparkDate_Brand_Source_of_Truth_1_Multi_Event.md. This is the source of truth for facts that do NOT change row to row; content/queue.csv is the day-by-day queue. scripts/lint-content-queue.js enforces every rule in here. When a fact changes, change it HERE and let the linter find the rows that contradict it -- do not fix captions one at a time.

universal._attendance_note: CHECK-IN COUNTS UNDERCOUNT ATTENDANCE. Not everyone who comes checks in -- attended.txt even records one guest who checked in under a different address than he bought under. So a figure higher than the check-in tally is NOT evidence of fabrication, and must not be reported as one. This file previously banned '28 attendees' as "unsourced" on exactly that mistaken reasoning, and the rule caused the same wrong conclusion to be re-derived more than once. Confirmed by Taylor 2026-08-22: 31 is the real number.

approved_stat.context: Event 1 attendance -- American Bar & Grill door count: 26 registered plus unregistered +1s

universal._pulled_images_note: These are pulled from every use, organic and paid. NO REASON IS RECORDED. The source (SparkDate_Brand_Source_of_Truth_1_Multi_Event.md) says only that they are pulled and that substitutes must come from the confirmed-consent list. Do not state or infer a cause -- an earlier generated brief asserted "consent withdrawn", which was never established and is a claim about a real person's decision. The rule is absolute; the reason is unknown.
universal._testimonials_note: Supplied 2026-08-22. Until then only the Quang quote existed, so both testimonial posts (MC-08, LX-20) ran it and the carousels split one quote across three frames. With six, a 3-slide testimonial post can show three different people -- which is what that beat is for. Short ones (Alex, James, Jeff) work best on a quote frame; they read at a glance. Note the CAPTIONS on MC-08 and LX-20 still quote only Quang; the slides now show more.

approved_testimonials.quote: Everyone was so lively and some of us connected so well we chatted well into the evening.
Hosts and event setup made me relaxed and able to talk freely. Met my match there and seeing where it goes from there!
Fantastic people & fantastic vibes. Great fun.

utm._note: utm_content was 'proof_rsa1' on all 45 rows, so GA4 could not attribute any individual post. It is now the row id. utm_campaign was 'Augweek3_lancaster'/'Augweek3_philly', which goes stale in September (blocker #23); it is now derived per event per month.

link_rules._note: Instagram captions never render a clickable link. IG captions must pair 'link in bio' phrasing with the utm_source=Instagram URL, never the Facebook one -- both point at the same landing page, so the wrong one silently misattributes.

universal.landing_page_warning: Organic and paid links both point at /lp. A funnel analysis found 422 paid users -> ~10 begin_checkout -> ZERO purchases there, concentrated in the Facebook/Instagram in-app browser. Organic bio-link traffic mostly opens in a real browser so it is lower-risk, but this is unresolved and worth watching.

open_issues: PRICE TRAP: $24.99 is Marion Court's REGULAR price but Loxleys EARLY-BIRD price. Same number, different meaning per event. Two live captions (LX-11, GG-7) had it as $18.99 by mistake; both fixed 8/19.
BLOCKER #3: the Eventbrite early-bird window must move from Sep 1 to Sep 7 11:59:59 PM. The entire Sep 7 deadline sequence depends on this one edit.
BLOCKER #4: the 2-for-1 ticket type must be live in Eventbrite before Sep 19, or the Sep 19 post promises something that does not exist.

calendar_template._comment: The reusable shape of a promo cycle, ported from the brand source-of-truth doc so it survives that file being archived. Offsets are days relative to the event date (T-0). Instantiate by picking an event date, converting each offset to a real date, and pulling name/venue/city/pricing/hashtags/link from that event's block above. The T-16..T+1 stretch is PROVEN -- it is what actually shipped for Marion Court and Loxley's, generalized. T-30..T-18 is a proposed longer runway that has never run live; treat it as a starting point, not gospel.
calendar_template._collision_warning: Two events running this template will land on overlapping dates -- Marion Court and Tellus collided twice. The linter's day-collision check catches same-day feed posts; it cannot decide which one should move.

asset_rules.naming: {row_id}[_{subtype}][_{N}of{Total}].{ext}, row_id zero-padded to two digits (MC-02.jpg, TL-01_1of3.jpg, MC-12_story.jpg)
asset_rules._naming_note: Zero-padding matters: without it MC-10 sorts before MC-2 and the folder falls out of posting order.
asset_rules._publish_format_note: Instagram's Content Publishing API accepts JPEG ONLY. Source exports are PNG in RGBA mode and cannot be handed to the API as-is; RGBA must be composited onto a background before JPEG encoding. TikTok also rejects PNG.

ig._note: No scheduling parameter exists and media containers expire after 24h, so the container must be created at publish time by the runner.

ig_story._note: A Story can be posted via API but link and countdown stickers CANNOT be attached -- that is where the link and the urgency live, so sticker Stories stay manual.

tiktok.canvas: 1080x1920, and NOT the Story canvas: TikTok reserves the right ~250px for its action rail and the bottom ~380px for the caption, where Instagram reserves the top and bottom instead. Square 1080x1080 art posts but letterboxes. Render the vertical set with build-campaign-export --vertical; the -tt filename suffix is what routes it.
tiktok.token_lifetime: Access tokens last ~24h and are minted per run from TIKTOK_REFRESH_TOKEN. The refresh token ROTATES -- if the new value is not saved to the secret, publishing dies at the next run and needs re-authorising by hand.
tiktok._note: UPLOAD_TO_DRAFT works without TikTok's audit; DIRECT_POST requires a 2-4 week review. Photo posts (up to 35 images) are supported, so existing carousels can post with no new video. Unaudited apps are capped at SELF_ONLY, so DIRECT_POST before approval succeeds and posts privately to nobody -- run social-preflight for the real allowed privacy levels. PULL_FROM_URL also requires sparkdate.date to be verified in the TikTok developer portal.

x._note: Manual by decision (2026-08-21). The queue still writes caption_x so posting is a paste. X also killed its free tier for new developers in Feb 2026; pay-per-use is $0.20 per post containing a link, and every post here has one.
